transformation.method: Long-format extraction from the official workbook's four original sheets; no historical derived CSV input.
transformation.missing_value_policy: Blank source cells remain blank; explicit numeric zero remains 0; no imputation.
transformation.date_policy: Week start is anchored to the first Reiwa-year header and validated against every printed start date/weekday. End-date discrepancies are preserved; period_end_date is blank for discrepant headers.
transformation.total_policy: 52本部合計 is read from cached Excel values and checked against numeric detail cells using Excel SUM blank-ignored semantics. Blank detail cells remain blank.
transformation.subgroup_policy: COVID-suspected and non-COVID-suspected remain separate source series; their sum is checked against overall values where all three values are numeric.

methodology_timeline.change: COVID-suspected inner-count item discontinued; weekly reporting of difficulty cases continues; monthly reporting ends; ambulance dispatch counts added to published figures.
methodology_timeline.pre_formal_period_handling: Workbook contains four weeks beginning 2020-03-30 through 2020-04-20 with numeric values, before the reported formal survey start date. Their collection provenance is unresolved; they are retained and explicitly flagged, not silently merged into the formal survey period.

limitations: The dataset describes the 52 fire departments included in the FDMA survey, not every fire department in Japan.
救急搬送困難事案 is not equivalent to ambulance refusal, non-transport, or inability to receive treatment.
The previous-year tab is paired by week index 364 days apart and retained as a separate comparator series.
The overall sheet has one blank facility-week observation; this is not converted to zero.

One overall-sheet header prints 2024-04-01 through 2024-04-08 although the validated seven-day interval is 2024-04-01 through 2024-04-07. Its raw header is preserved and period_end_date is blank for that interval.

The workbook contains four weeks beginning 2020-03-30 through 2020-04-20 with numeric values before the reported formal survey start date of 2020-04-27. Their collection provenance is unresolved; the rows are retained with an explicit phase flag and must not be assumed comparable to the formal survey period.
From 2024-04-08, the new form discontinued the COVID-suspected inner-count item while continuing the overall difficulty-case survey; the COVID subgroup series therefore ends before the form change.
This is a descriptive weekly dataset and does not establish causal effects of COVID-19 on transport difficulty.
